NativeInvitationConfig.description: Deployment fallbacks supplied to the owner settings capability.
NativeInvitationConfig.title: NativeInvitationConfig

x-receipts: Success receipts bind operation ID, actor ID (nullable only for public registration), operation, HMAC request fingerprint and derivation epoch. They store token-free result data, no raw bearer/proof/link/password/ciphertext, and have no User or Invitation foreign key.
x-lock-order: Lock participating User authority rows in UUID order using KEY SHARE first; quota creates upgrade the inviter to UPDATE before email. Then acquire the existing email advisory key hashtextextended(email,0), Project, and Invitation/ProjectMember. Project ownership is captured through Workspace before User locks and revalidated while Project remains locked. Batch preview performs the real ordered writes and Audit inside a private PL/pgSQL subtransaction, then rolls it all back with one exact sentinel.
x-outbox: Invitation mail reuses public.identity_credential_mail_outbox with purpose=invitation; outbox.id is the stable send operation ID, actor_id stores issuer, invitation_context stores project snapshot, sender actor triple and typed Audit context. The authoritative raw token stays only on user_invitations; outbox stores the encrypted token, hash and key epoch.
